basic_info.description: 5828-5830 California Street, is an Edwardian fixer duplex in the highly coveted Lake Street District that presents a rare opportunity for developers, investors, or discerning homeowners eager to design and build their dream home. Each full floor flat features two-bedrooms plus sunroom, a formal dining room, a living room w/fireplace, a kitchen with a separate pantry plus in unit laundry and one split bath. Tandem parking for two cars and two bonus storage rooms on the garage level.  Tiered sunny yard with much potential. Lovely Edwardian Details throughout. It's a fantastic chance to create a spectacular haven or investment! Property to be delivered vacant. A+ location !
